svg.title: Embodied agent orchestration with memory inside the VLM
svg.desc: A VLM reasoning model — whose context window IS the memory — selects tools from a registry containing vla, perceive, relocate, and done. Observation consists of an external scene camera, a wrist camera, and text state. Two RGB-D cameras provide sensing; depth is used deterministically and not fed to the VLM. The system runs a closed perception-reasoning-action loop.

g.text: Reads full context, selects tool + args

svg.text: Arm and two RGB-D cameras; depth used deterministically, not by VLM
